waiturn.title: Waiturn
waiturn.summary: Appointments, queues and daily workflows for barbershops. My own project with a relational database, protected APIs and real-time updates.
waiturn.problem: Appointment booking and walk-in queues should work together in one application.
waiturn.solution: Public booking and queue flows, together with internal management workflows, are implemented in the repository.
waiturn.architecture: Next.js and TypeScript; Prisma with PostgreSQL; Better Auth for authentication. Application logic, data access and HTTP interfaces are separated.
waiturn.challenges: Access checks by shop and role, consistent appointment processing and event delivery with Socket.IO.
waiturn.validation: Unit tests for business logic and access checks, plus Playwright scenarios for authentication and multiple tabs, are present. No current test results are claimed here.
waiturn.statusNote: Active development. The code is private; no public demo is linked at present.

orla-plus.title: ORLA+
orla-plus.summary: Hero, CTAs, mobile navigation and a multilingual landing page. Three integrated pull requests show my contributions to an existing application.
orla-plus.problem: The landing page needed clearer navigation on small screens and support for international visitors.
orla-plus.solution: Hero and CTA improvements (#5), mobile navigation (#6) and internationalisation in PT-BR, EN and ES (#8).
orla-plus.architecture: The evidenced landing page contributions use HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Migration to Next.js App Router is a separate work in progress.
orla-plus.challenges: Improve the existing design and navigation without rebuilding the website; adapt layouts for desktop, tablet and mobile.
orla-plus.validation: Three PRs authored by Willianfonseca7 were integrated into develop; the PRs document visual checks and review feedback.
orla-plus.statusNote: Public website; the Next.js migration is not complete.
orla-plus.migrationNote: Current work in progress (self-reported): Next.js App Router layouts, pages and components are structured. API integration is still pending.

growthbot-de.title: GrowthBot-DE
growthbot-de.summary: Process Telegram messages, classify interests and generate recommendations through the OpenAI API, with structured validation and SQLite persistence.
growthbot-de.problem: A Telegram assistant should turn messages into a traceable recommendation flow.
growthbot-de.solution: Handle messages and callbacks, classify interests using keywords and generate structured LLM responses.
growthbot-de.architecture: Next.js / TypeScript, Telegram integration and OpenAI API. Zod validates webhook data and JSON responses; SQLite stores conversation history.
growthbot-de.challenges: Detect duplicate webhook updates, validate input and handle external service errors. Interest classification is rule-based.
growthbot-de.validation: Unit and integration tests cover handlers, classification, persistence and the recommendation flow; a Playwright scenario is also present.
growthbot-de.statusNote: Public web demo and repository. Bot operation depends on configured external services.

invest-agent.title: InvestAgent
invest-agent.summary: TypeScript monorepo with a React dashboard, Node.js API and worker. Market analysis, capital management and risk checks are separated into modules.
invest-agent.problem: Market data, analysis and background processing should share domain logic while staying separate from the interface.
invest-agent.solution: Fetch Binance market data, calculate technical indicators and display structured analysis and risk data in the dashboard.
invest-agent.architecture: npm Workspaces with web, API and worker; shared modules for strategy, capital, portfolio and risk. Docker and CI configurations are present.
invest-agent.challenges: Shared types between API and UI, independent worker processing and traceable risk checks.
invest-agent.validation: Tests exist for selected risk, capital, portfolio and execution modules. CI includes lint and build jobs.
invest-agent.statusNote: Public demo. Execution code and simulation paths exist; live trading and financial results are not claimed.
